name: AI Readiness Accelerator Delivery Workflow
description: Coordinate an evidence-based AI readiness consulting engagement from authorization and discovery through assessment, opportunity prioritization, roadmap, proposal, statement of work, and implementation handoff.
trigger: An authorized client or internal sponsor requests an evidence-based AI readiness assessment and actionable implementation roadmap.

stages.name: Authorize and scope
stages.action: Confirm authority, stakeholders, objectives, data boundaries, schedule, and evidence plan.

stages.name: Discover current state
stages.action: Run AA-SKL-000001 and AA-SKL-000002; reconcile evidence, contradictions, and confidence.

stages.name: Analyze opportunities and controls
stages.action: Run AA-SKL-000003, AA-SKL-000005, AA-SKL-000006, and AA-SKL-000007 using common assumptions and evidence IDs.

stages.name: Build roadmap
stages.action: Run AA-SKL-000004 and establish initiatives, gates, owners, dependencies, measures, and sequencing.

stages.name: Validate decisions
stages.action: Present findings, distinguish facts from assumptions, record sponsor decisions, and obtain approval for commercial scoping.

stages.name: Prepare engagement package
stages.action: Run AA-SKL-000008, AA-SKL-000009, and AA-SKL-000010 with aligned scope, price assumptions, acceptance, and change control.

stages.name: Independent quality gate
stages.action: Verify traceability, arithmetic, scope consistency, risks, permissions, deliverable completeness, and approval evidence.

completion_criteria: Every material finding has evidence and confidence
Client decisions and unresolved assumptions are recorded
Roadmap, proposal, statement of work, and implementation plan use consistent scope
Final deliverables pass the quality gate

failure_policy.escalation: Stop the affected stage, preserve evidence and the last approved state, and escalate authority, privacy, safety, legal, financial, or irreconcilable scope issues to the accountable owner.
